chapters.heading: The problem
body: Hikers, site workers and long-distance travellers usually choose between carrying enough clean water for the whole trip, which is heavy, or drawing water on the way and accepting the risk.
Most filter bottles on the market only filter. They do not deal with the biological side, so a separate device is still needed to boil.

chapters.heading: The approach
body: The bottle folds three jobs into one object: it holds water, filters it through a core running down the body, and heats it on an electric base under the bottom.
The body is ribbed so it stays put in a wet hand. The lid carries a hook for a rucksack, and the handle folds flat against the body when it is not in use.
points: Filter core pulls out to be washed or replaced
Hook and handle sit within the bottle's own volume

chapters.heading: Construction
body: Eight parts, with each material chosen for the job that part actually does: aluminium where heat passes through, ABS where it is held, silicone where it has to seal.
